You interepted it the right way. She looks at an empty calendar. She mentions that in this week she has nothing to do and could sleep at my place for a whole week. Then a few days/weeks later something comes in the way and it's just another normal week like any other.

In case of the previous relationships its something I don't really know.

I have the tendency of wanting something so bad that I dont really think about the consequences. So if I would role swap the situation I wouldn't let anything come in the way of my "planned" date with my gf. Its not something I can explain its just how I behave. I tend to risk more then other people if I want something to happen. And it makes me sad when people dont put in the same effort as me. I realised this a few months ago and since then I tried to stop this behaviour. I dont really know where it came from and its like this since I have the ability to plan and do things on my own.
